review:
Toshi Ways Club is a retro gaming-themed ways slot built on Flash Frames. Winning positions are framed and stay on the grid, and the symbols inside reveal new ones; further wins add more frames until nothing new wins.

A Swap scatter landing with Flash Frames reveals one paying symbol and turns every framed position into it, which can create a big combined win. Three FS symbols trigger the Retro Reboot bonus with 10 free spins. Hacksaw doesn't publish RTP, volatility or max win outside the game, so check the demo's info screen. It suits players who like chain-reaction mechanics.
